outcome.Summary: Added tags and due dates to tasker, keeping the model/store/query/cli layering. `model.Task` gained `Tags []string` (json `tags,omitempty`) and `Due *time.Time` (`due,omitempty`); `Validate` normalises tags (trim, lower-case, de-dup, sort, regex `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$` → new `model.ErrBadTag`) and pins due dates to UTC midnight via `model.DueDate`. `store.Version` is now 2 (v1 files still load; saves upgrade). `query.Options` gained `Tags` (all-tags filter), `Overdue` (open tasks due strictly before the passed UTC-midnight `Today`) and a `due` sort key (ascending, nil-due last, ties by ID). The CLI adds `--tag`/`--due` to `add`, `--tag`/`--untag`/`--due YYYY-MM-DD|none` to `edit`, `--tag`/`--overdue`/`--sort due` to `list`, a new `tags` command (counts of tags on open tasks, sorted), and `FormatTask` now appends ` (due …)` and `[tag,tag]`; invalid dates/tags are usage errors (exit 2) and `cli.Run`/`Env.Now` remain the entry point. Added tests in all four packages plus a v1→v2 migration test and README update; verified with `go vet ./... && go test ./...` (all pass), gofmt clean, and a real-binary smoke test.
